# Kazi Shakib

> Finance Instructor · Software Builder · Chess Player (Mirpur, Dhaka-1216, Bangladesh). I live in Mirpur, Dhaka, where I teach finance, build software tools, and play competitive chess. As a Finance Instructor at Mentors Brother, I teach corporate finance, valuation methods (IRR, Payback Period, EBITDA), and Time Value of Money (TVM) to 100+ students, helping at-risk students achieve a 100% pass rate.
